g.text: Completions Daily Rollup remains unresolved. A gateway rebind was proposed because retries would
reproduce the repeated failure, but the authorised approver denied rebinding to gw-onprem-02 during
finance close week. A change request is required.
The on-premises gateway gw-onprem-01 was unavailable, causing the same GatewayUnavailable
error across three consecutive scheduled refreshes.
Repoints this dataset to gw-onprem-02. Other datasets bound to either gateway may be
affected, and in-flight refreshes will fail.
gw-onprem-02 also serves the finance datasets. Not during close week - raise a change
NOT APPROVED: gw-onprem-02 also serves the finance

- **Action taken**: No remediation performed. Proposed rebinding from gw-onprem-01 to gw-onprem-02,
- **Outcome**: Refresh remains unresolved; gateway rebind was not approved.
The same GatewayUnavailable failure occurred on three consecutive scheduled refreshes (2026-08-25
through 2026-08-27), so another refresh would not help. Data-quality review found 0 duplicate rows
in well_production across (well_id, production_date). Approval was denied because gw-onprem-02
